text: A fan knife fell from the student's waistband while climbing the stairs to the fourth floor.
Guards took a slingshot and a pouch of steel pellets from the student at the entrance.
An unlabelled strip of tablets a classmate identified as ecstasy was taken from the student's pocket.
Three empty beer cans and a warm six-pack were found under the seat the student had been using.
The student was refilling a vape pod with flavoured liquid at the back stairwell.
The student pocketed a phone left charging in the study area and did not turn it in after the owner asked around.
Itinago ng estudyante ang laptop ng kaklase sa sarili niyang bag at hindi ito isinauli kahit hinahanap na ito.
The student tapped the ID on the reader at the gate and walked through when the light turned green.
The student handed a phone found in the study area to the guard, who logged it in the turnover record.
The student stayed in the laboratory after hours under a written extension approved by the dean and countersigned by the technician.
The student declared prescribed antibiotics at the clinic and was issued a slip to carry them on campus.
After eating, the student wiped the table and placed the tray and utensils in the bussing area.
The room was loud because the instructor had the class do a graded recitation drill that period.
The student's hair was uncoloured and tied back neatly for the laboratory session.
Log entry: student went past the second floor landing at around noon.
The student signed out a reference book at the counter and read it at the table until closing time.
The student lit an ordinary cigarette at the parking area and was seen exhaling smoke.
A cardboard sword built for the theater production was carried through the lobby to the auditorium.
The two students knocked into each other rounding a blind corner and each said sorry before moving on.
Told twice to present identification, the student said no and kept walking toward the elevators.
